the salt dependence of ΔG(el) is a useful tool for understanding the physical basis of electrostatics in ligand-nucleotide acid complexes, but the interpretation of experimental binding data in terms of the electrostatic and noneelectrostatic components of the binding free energy must be made with caution.

the salt dependence of ΔG(el) can be understood in terms of the electrostatic interactions between the charged groups of the ligand and nucleic acid.
